purpose: Version the interpretation of confirmed source facts separately from fixed scoring arithmetic.

rules.all: Any confirmed false is false; otherwise missing evidence is unknown; all confirmed true is true.
rules.any: Any confirmed true is true; otherwise missing evidence is unknown; all confirmed false is false.
rules.escape: Only paths with no verificationNeeded earn confirmed-exit credit. Missing starts, routes, connectors or alternatives remain unknown. Complete recorded shared-chokepoint geometry may establish a robustness gap.
rules.water: Accessible is a disjunction over recorded water items; expired items are unusable. Quantity uses the authoritative inventory ledger including units, expiry and access.
rules.transport: Disjunction of recorded vehicle and alternative availability; no recorded arrangement is unknown.
rules.assistance: Applies to step-free needs, explicit evacuation helper needs, deaf/hard-of-hearing needs, infants and children. Missing helper identity is unknown; invalid or self identity is false. Assignment does not prove reach or simultaneous capacity.
rules.pets: Conjunction of recorded carrier availability; missing availability is unknown.
rules.stress: Only source-bound findings in the approved geometry envelope may affect robustness; concern-scoped hypothetical traces cannot enter scoring.
rules.shelter: Use ShelterSuitability.confirmedRoom and EgressPlanner interiorShelter purpose, matching rehearsal. Confirmed suitable planning choice earns suitable; all occupants need actual paths without verification requirements for reachable. Missing/invalid candidates or routes remain unknown; no engineered-safe-room claim or hazard N/A inference.
rules.foodAccess: Use confirmed inventory food access and expiry with three-valued disjunction. A PreparationFact location string does not prove access.
rules.foodQuantity: If food items are recorded, use householdFoodGap and project the result atomically into legacy household food-days. Count explicit whole-household coverage days only; count/weight packages or partial-person stock cannot be converted to household days. Unknown cannot retain an older positive total. Without food ledger items, preserve legacy confirmed household-days. The 3-day draft rubric horizon is limited; S64 recommends 2 weeks for home, distinct from 3 days for evacuation.
rules.usableAccess: Validated user-confirmed access may be recorded independently of unknown quantity, but confirmed total zero, usable zero or expiry cannot earn usable-supply-access credit. An empty container is not a usable supply. Zero total bounds usable quantity to zero even when that latter field is unknown.
rules.decodedInventory: Read arithmetic and assessment revalidate decoded ledger facts with the same field/origin/identity validation as confirmation. Non-user origins cannot impersonate confirmed inventory. Duplicate IDs/physical IDs in a confirmation batch reject atomically; nonfinite conversions or sums reject before persistence or state publication.
rules.subjectScope: Subject-restricted positive stock is never pooled into a household-wide calculation unless it covers every recorded household person. Partial coverage is explicitly scopeUnsupported and unknown, preserving physical stock. Per-person exercise allocation is unsupported; aggregate forecasting abstains. A sufficient independently shared pool may establish a zero baseline deficit. Generic recorded requirements use the same scope check: an unnamed requirement cannot consume person-reserved stock; duplicate or empty subject IDs are invalid.
rules.essentialsIdentity: Only an explicitly user-reviewed preparationKind (flashlight or firstAidKit) maps broad inventory categories into existing essentials predicates. Count units, compatible category, expiry, access, subject scope and usable amounts apply. Generic lights/bandages do not imply these preparations. Confirmation projects the same ledger into legacy fields atomically; replacement with generic identity clears stale projected credit. Sanitation adequacy is not inferred from generic stock.

migration: Preserve historical cards and accepted predicates. Legacy absent assessmentVersion decodes as unversioned. Reject mixed policy versions within one compilation. Reassessment requires a new identified snapshot and must not be displayed as earned improvement.
limitations: Unknowns retain fixed rubric budgets and may trigger the unverified critical cap.
Assistance policy and conditional criteria require qualified review.
No new safety, physical-capacity or clinical claim is made.
